title: Missing Bridges: Composition-Aware Active Imitation Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.18004v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Active imitation learning reduces expert effort by allowing a learner to request the demonstrations it needs. Existing methods typically select these requests for their expected information gain about the expert policy. In structured multi-task domains, however, the number of start-goal tasks may grow combinatorially despite their solutions sharing reusable behavior. This makes composable behaviors especially valuable, since a single demonstration may help solve many tasks at once. Prior methods do not explicitly account for this value when selecting which demonstration to request. We introduce Adaptive Agents via Latent Topologies (AALT), which requests demonstrations that maximize expected gains in start-goal connectivity. We further show that this objective is formally tied to information gain about task reachability. translated_title: 缺失的桥梁：组合感知的主动模仿学习
translated_abstract: 主动模仿学习通过允许学习者请求所需的演示来减少专家的工作量。现有方法通常根据对专家策略的预期信息增益来选择这些请求。然而，在结构化的多任务领域中，尽管起点-目标任务的解决方案共享可复用的行为，这些任务的数量仍可能呈组合式增长。这使得可组合行为尤其有价值，因为单个演示可能有助于同时解决许多任务。先前的方法在选择请求哪个演示时并未明确考虑这一价值。我们提出了通过潜在拓扑实现自适应智能体，该方法请求能够最大化起点-目标连通性预期增益的演示。我们进一步证明，该目标在形式上与任务可达性的信息增益相关联。AALT将现有的演示组织成一个由学习行为连接的潜在枢纽状态拓扑，并识别……
tldr: 本文提出AALT方法，通过请求能最大化起点-目标连通性预期增益的演示，实现组合感知的主动模仿学习，使单个演示能够帮助解决多个组合式增长的起点-目标任务。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes AALT, which performs composition-aware active imitation learning by requesting demonstrations that maximize expected gains in start-goal connectivity, enabling a single demonstration to help solve many tasks in combinatorially growing multi-task domains.
